products.name: Flex Access
products.terms: Redemption on business days. Settlement the next business day. Principal is not guaranteed. No expected rate of return is specified.

products.name: Six-Month Lock
products.terms: No redemption during the 180-day lock-up. Principal is not guaranteed.

products.name: Legacy Income
products.terms: Closed to new subscriptions. Existing holdings may be redeemed. Redemption fee is 1% before day 90 and 0% from day 90 onwards.
